purpose: Teach: 慰霊/機関車/時効/パトカー/系譜/恐慌/靖国神社/内蔵

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の、本気で、絶対、慰霊、絶対、式、絶対、毎年、絶対、参加しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We at the police take the annual memorial ceremony very seriously. We attend every year without fail.
lines.style: Formal, measured tone. Clear enunciation. Professional composure. Slight weight on the word 'seriously.' Steady eye contact. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 歴史的、本気で、絶対、機関車、絶対、保存、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、ご対応ですか?本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the police department handles the security and preservation of the historical locomotive site?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity. Soft, almost hesitant opening. Leaning slightly forward. Interest without pushiness. A sincere question, not a test.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、時効、絶対、間近、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Given that the statute of limitations on this case is approaching soon, we're proceeding very carefully.
lines.style: Measured, procedural. Slight emphasis on 'carefully.' Professional distance maintained. Speaking as representative, not as individual. Steady tempo.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、パトカー、絶対、新型、絶対、導入、絶対、されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I see. I heard the police have been introducing new patrol car models recently.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation. Slight pause before speaking. Not interrogating—genuinely noting something. Interested but not urgent. Warm underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の、本気で、絶対、系譜、絶対、警察、絶対、調査しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently investigating the suspect's background and connections thoroughly.
lines.style: Professional, steady delivery. Matter-of-fact. No apology or elaboration. The confidence of someone stating procedure. Brief, complete.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 金融、本気で、絶対、恐慌、絶対、後、絶対、警察、絶対、治安、絶対、注視ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That makes sense. After the financial crisis, the police have been paying close attention to public safety, haven't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, connecting pieces. Slow, considered. Not challenging—agreeing while demonstrating understanding. A note of respect for the work involved.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、靖国神社、絶対、参拝日、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been strengthening security measures, particularly around the Yasukuni Shrine on commemorative visit days.
lines.style: Formal, deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'strengthening.' Speaking from institutional knowledge. Professional weight. No hedging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察車両に、本気for、絶対、内蔵、絶対、された、絶対、最新機材、絶対、活用、絶対、されているんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: It's good to hear that police vehicles are equipped with the latest technology and that it's being put to full use.
lines.style: Approving, warm underneath. Recognition of competence. Gentle closing—almost like drawing a respectful conclusion. Sincere, not flattering. Soft landing on final words.
